messages:
maya: Quick sync 8 Optimize toolkit 8 dependency lanes. Need a distilled priority map for Sales + Eng by Monday.

sam: I can draft. Question: separate lanes for Dedicated vs Hosted?

jordan: Yes. Lane A (Dedicated/Enterprise): full cache + quant + eval-alerts. Lane B (Hosted/SMB): batching + ephemeral cache, quant opt-in.

liam: Flag: quant can change outputs. We need an automated concordance gate >=80% before enabling in production.

maya: Gate list proposal: 1) SDK telemetry + schema; 2) batching perf validation (>=15% p95 gain); 3) cache hit >=20% in smoke; 4) quant concordance >=80% (3 runs); 5) eval-alert FP rate <10%.

nina: Who owns SDK telemetry? We require token-level timings and model_variant metadata.

sam: I'll own telemetry if runtime provides trace points (1 FTE). ETA 3w.

jordan: I'll add runtime dependency on sprint board and draft rollback runbook: fallback to FP32 variant -> notify customers -> open ticket.

liam: Rough concordance harness sketch:
```
baseline: model-x-fp32
quant: model-x-8bit
metric: semantic-similarity + structure-match
pass: concordance >=0.80 over n=500
```

maya: Prioritized workstreams: telemetry -> batching -> cache -> quant pipeline -> eval-alerts. Also need rough cost delta per 1M tokens for Sales.

sam: noted. I'll include cost stub.

deploy-bot: CI /optimize/telemetry schema tests passing on feature/telemetry-schema.

maya: OK team. Sam + Jordan finalize telemetry schema by Fri; Liam drafts concordance harness; Nina pulls pilot prompt sets from CSM. If no objections by EOD Friday we lock sprint scope. :thumbsup:
